desc:
Welcome to Fede Vigevani's Madness! 🤡🚪

Dare to step into the most famous and mysterious house in all of Roblox? Get ready for an unforgettable Roleplay experience based on the universe of Fede Vigevani!

What can you do in the game?

🏠 Explore the House: Tour every corner of Fede's house, including the most secret places.

🤡 Beware of the Clowns!: Will you face your fears or join them?

📹 Record Your Own Video: Recreate the most iconic scenes from Fede videos with your friends.

🔑 Solve Mysteries: Discover the hidden secrets Fede has left behind throughout the property.

🎭 Roleplay: Become Faith, one of the neighbors, or create your own character.

Gather your team, secure the doors and get ready for the action!

👍 Give them LIKE and FAVORITE for more updates and new hiding places! ⭐
